comment: Named RNG streams and seed vocabulary (docs/design/08, PF-07; ported from the shipped engine/rng.js). Each stream is derived from (seed XOR fnv1a(streamName)); ORDER DOES NOT AFFECT VALUES. Codegen emits the RngStream enum from 'streams' in order — append new streams at the end. 'core2Streams' are the web's src/engine/rng.js STREAM_NAMES after these at b8cfe4fac (Core 2, docs/design/11 WP-0): kept apart so the 405 run, combat and map documents, which record every stream's counter, stay as the oracle fixtures have them. Tools/transform-content.mjs fails unless streams followed by core2Streams equals the web's list; Core2RngStream is the enum over core2Streams. WP-3 merges the two when the run switches to Core 2.
